cmsPages.title: About Gayatri Stationers
cmsPages.summary: Serving students, schools, artists, and offices with genuine stationery, notebooks, exam kits, and institutional supplies.
cmsPages.contentMarkdown:
### Our Retail Heritage
Gayatri Stationers is a dedicated stationery and educational supply retailer offering school notebooks, writing instruments, fine art supplies, DIY craft essentials, geometry boxes, and office files.

### Dual Fulfilment Convenience
- **Store Pickup Counter (₹0 Fee):** Reserve your stationery items online and collect your packed order directly from our retail pickup counter using your 6-character Pickup Code.
- **PIN-Verified Home Delivery:** Fast doorstep dispatch across serviceable PIN codes with transparent shipping thresholds.

### Genuine Brands & GST Invoicing
We stock authentic products from trusted Indian and international stationery manufacturers including ITC Classmate, DOMS, Kokuyo Camlin, Faber-Castell, Unomax, Flair, Hauser, Casio, and Solo.
cmsPages.seoDescription: Learn about Gayatri Stationers retail and institutional stationery store.

cmsPages.title: Store Pickup Information
cmsPages.summary: How to buy online and collect your order from the Gayatri Stationers counter with zero delivery fee.
cmsPages.contentMarkdown:
### How Store Pickup Works
1. **Select Store Pickup at Checkout:** Choose *Option A: Store Pickup* during checkout. No shipping fee is charged.
2. **Flexible Payment:** Pay online via Razorpay (when configured) or select **Pay at Store Counter** to pay by Cash or UPI when you collect your bag.
3. **Wait for Ready Notification:** Our store staff picks and packs your items from shelf inventory and updates your order status to **Ready for Pickup**.
4. **Present Your 6-Character Pickup Code:** Show your Order Number and 6-character Pickup Code at the Gayatri Stationers counter for instant handover.
cmsPages.seoDescription: Buy stationery online and pick up at the Gayatri Stationers retail counter.

cmsPages.title: Shipping & Home Delivery Policy
cmsPages.summary: PIN-code serviceability, delivery fees, free shipping thresholds, and dispatch timelines.
cmsPages.contentMarkdown:
### PIN-Code Serviceability
Home delivery is available for serviceable PIN codes configured in the store's delivery table. Enter your 6-digit PIN code during checkout to verify serviceability, estimated delivery days, and Cash on Delivery (COD) eligibility.

### Delivery Charges & Free Delivery Threshold
Each serviceable zone specifies a standard delivery fee and a minimum order value above which doorstep delivery is completely free.

### Dispatch & Tracking
Once packed and handed over to our local delivery staff or courier partner, your order status updates to **Dispatched** and **Out for Delivery** on the Live Order Tracker.
cmsPages.seoDescription: PIN-code delivery coverage, shipping charges, and dispatch timelines.

cmsPages.title: Returns, Exchanges & Refund Policy
cmsPages.summary: Clear guidelines for damaged items, wrong dispatches, cancellations, and refunds.
cmsPages.contentMarkdown:
### Eligibility for Returns or Replacement
If you receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect stationery item, please report it within 48 hours of collection or delivery with your Order Number.

### Non-Returnable Items
Opened ink bottles, used markers, custom-printed institutional notebooks, and unsealed art colour tubes cannot be returned unless manufacturing defects are verified.

### Refund Processing
Approved refunds are logged and processed back to the original payment method or settled at the store counter.
cmsPages.seoDescription: Return, replacement, and refund policy for Gayatri Stationers orders.

cmsPages.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
cmsPages.summary: Answers to common questions about store pickup codes, bulk school orders, GST invoices, and stock.
cmsPages.contentMarkdown:
### Can I pay at the store when picking up my online order?
Yes. Select **Store Pickup** and choose **Pay at Store Counter**. Your items are reserved immediately and you can pay via Cash or UPI upon collection.

### Do you supply bulk stationery to schools and offices?
Yes. Visit our **Bulk Orders** page to submit your institutional requirement list with optional GSTIN for wholesale quotes.

### Are all catalogue prices inclusive of GST?
Yes, all listed MRP and selling prices include applicable GST, with the tax component itemized on your checkout summary and order receipt.
cmsPages.seoDescription: FAQs about store pickup, home delivery, GST invoicing, and bulk stationery orders.

cmsPages.title: Contact Us & Store Hours
cmsPages.summary: Store pickup desk details, business hours, and institutional enquiry support.
cmsPages.contentMarkdown:
### Retail Pickup Counter & Support Desk
Refer to the verified store address, pickup counter hours, and support phone/WhatsApp configured by the Store Owner in **Store Settings**.

### Institutional & Wholesale Desk
For school booklists, examination kits, and corporate office stationery contracts, use the **Bulk Orders** form for priority quotation.
cmsPages.seoDescription: Contact Gayatri Stationers for retail pickup, order support, and bulk enquiries.

cmsPages.title: Privacy Policy & Terms of Service
cmsPages.summary: How customer contact details, order records, and payment verifications are safeguarded.
cmsPages.contentMarkdown:
### Customer Data Protection
We collect only the contact details (name, mobile number, email, and delivery address) required to fulfil your Store Pickup or Home Delivery orders and send order status updates.

### Payment Security
Online payments are processed through server-verified payment gateways. We never store raw card numbers or UPI PINs.
